verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs say Open Terminal lets users pick real coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex from the model picker, and that the AI can install dependencies, write the app, start its server and inspect output. Open WebUI Computer adds files, terminal, editor, git and AI agents, so this goes beyond snippets in chat. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the repo-clone and test-run workflow, detail on how the agents are supervised or approved, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the assistant can supervise or embed real coding agents so it does repo work — cloning, editing, testing — not just snippets in chat

citations.quote: Pick Claude Code, Codex or another listed agent from the model picker like any other model.
Your AI can install dependencies, write the app, start its server, and inspect the output.
serves your whole computer to any browser: files, terminal, editor, git, browser tabs, running sessions, AI agents, and tools.
